verdict.rationale: Railway documents a CLI for local development/deployment and an MCP server for AI-powered workflows, which could allow agentic interaction, but explicit public API documentation (e.g., OpenAPI/GraphQL spec) was not found — a probe for standard OpenAPI endpoints returned 404 across all candidate paths. Missing for 10: a documented REST/GraphQL API reference, and evidence of AI agents using it directly (independent corroboration).
